author: eapyk
text: Cloudflare Workers AI GLM-5.3 model returned information from other customers' private requests in responses: cross-tenant data leak in an AI inference platform, no prompt injection required.

author: OscarShipsAi
text: CVSS 10: one unauthenticated request to a LiteLLM Enterprise proxy could leak the master key and provider API keys. Fixed in 1.103.10, 1.104.8, 1.105.6, 1.106.5. Patch and rotate keys.

author: pbsIdentity
text: Symantec uncovered an autonomous AI-driven cyberattack tool with a 'Skynet mode' designed to find AI models to hijack for attacks.

author: morphisec
text: Storm-0940 (China) used the ARTEX agentic AI framework to weaponize the ConnectWise supply chain attack, generating 2,900 sign-in failures per minute.

author: tekroch
text: Cyber Kendra reports an AI app builder says an attacker got into production systems Oct 27 and took encrypted API keys of about 0.2% of users; all users asked to rotate keys.

author: threatpodium
text: CVE-2026-46300 (Linux kernel, CVSS 7.8, high) is actively exploited per CISA KEV.

author: abel_aguzmans
text: Arista says CVE-2026-114625 in on-prem VeloCloud Orchestrator is actively exploited: any logged-in user, including read-only, can gain operator rights. Added to CISA KEV.

author: TuringCyberObs
text: CVE-2026-112353: stored XSS in GFI KerioConnect Webmail actively exploited via malicious SVG attachments to steal credentials and sessions.

author: engrbilalwaris
text: Apple backported its fix for actively exploited CoreGraphics flaw CVE-2026-86950 (CVSS 8.8) to iOS/iPadOS 18.7.11 for older devices.

author: TheExploitHQ
text: PHP active exploitation confirmed: CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619 RCE; update to PHP 8.5.12, 8.4.27, 8.3.36 or 8.2.35.

author: Tesla_Optimus_K
text: AI agents hacked Anthropic through vendor software. Cathedral used AI agents to break into Anthropic via third-party admin and sales tools inside Anthropic's own bug bounty; agents found meeting transcripts, salary data and Slack messages in under twelve hours.

author: FatimaYappin
text: Anthropic is reportedly underplaying a recent security breach where an entity named Cathedral achieved full administrator access to their Slack workspace.

author: AiRiskBytes
text: Microsoft named the actor behind the ConnectWise supply-chain attack: a China-aligned group running ARTEX, an open-source AI pen-testing framework; first contact to privileged cloud access in under three hours.

author: DFIR_Radar
text: AI-assisted extortion operation n0n hit 93 victims, demanded $283.7M total, and ran its entire attack toolkit through an LLM coding agent.

author: NeuralAlphaAI
text: Langflow CVE-2026-105740 (CVSS 9.9): any logged-in user could run code on the server by adding an MCP server with stdio transport. Honeypots logged 1,700+ attempts.

author: WebWrightAI
text: AWS API MCP Server did not check token audience before 1.6.0; a token issued to another app in the same tenant was accepted. CVE-2026-115413

author: AgentFieldKit
text: Two MCP clients fixed sign-in flaws that let a malicious MCP server run commands: MCP Inspector (2.12.0 / 1.0.3) and OpenCode on Windows/WSL (1.18.33+). No CVEs.

author: DFIR_Radar
text: Trojanized LiteLLM 1.107.0 pushed to PyPI and Docker on Oct 21 hooks Python startup to steal credentials; traced to an unrotated key giving CI/CD control.

author: Dekrov_Dev
text: 42 GitHub repositories weaponized with AI-tool autorun hooks; JFrog found malicious triggers for Claude Code, Gemini, Cursor and VS Code.

author: DFIR_Radar
text: Aokigahara infostealer adds collection routines targeting local AI coding assistants.

author: cloudsa
text: Warp breach exposed agent decision logs via a third-party vendor (~1% of ~800,000 users). OpenCode lost stored OpenAI, Anthropic and Google API keys.

author: SJ_X_fo_me
text: Command Code announced it detected and stopped a security incident and revoked all customer API keys as a precaution.

author: sjandfun
text: Check Point found fake GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus desktop apps on GitHub pages bundling real installers with a crypto miner.

author: bigrkg
text: Black October incident roll-up: Railway env vars read and some decrypted, wallets with keys on Railway drained (~$371k, unconfirmed link), Zeabur lost 3.2M env vars.

author: undercode_news
text: CISA warns of actively exploited Node2Shell vulnerability as critical Node.js RCE risk emerges.

author: jorgeliauw
text: Node2Shell (CVE-2026-111497) is actively exploited in the wild and added to CISA KEV; attack traffic targeting Node.js 24.22.0.

author: gettransilience
text: CVE-2026-111497 (CVSS 9.2) in Google's Brotli decoder is actively exploited and in CISA KEV; affects Node.js, Python, .NET, Bun, Envoy, Istio.

author: CyberWatchFloor
text: CISA added Adobe Commerce PolyShell (CVE-2026-48356) and Brotli (CVE-2026-111497) to KEV; hundreds of stores already hit.

author: SBSentinellive
text: Adobe Commerce / Magento flaw CVE-2026-48356 lets attackers upload code; actively exploited, patch by Nov 10.

author: rishikagupta__
text: PHP2Shell: unauthenticated RCE hitting PHP-FPM and mod_php, actively exploited per CISA. Fix: 8.2.35 / 8.3.36 / 8.4.27 / 8.5.12.

author: SecurityAr58409
text: CVE-2026-109618: PHP2Shell unauthenticated RCE actively exploited.

author: shahzadFreelanc
text: Microsoft patched actively exploited Windows Shell zero-day CVE-2026-96951 (CVSS 8.8) bypassing Mark-of-the-Web.

author: FTMQNews
text: Apple patches actively exploited CoreGraphics zero-day on older devices.

author: leonov_av
text: Windows ALPC EoP (CVE-2026-85880) exploited in the wild; Check Point Quantum Gateway unauth RCE (CVE-2026-85102) actively exploited.

author: Daily_CyberSec
text: SignalWire patched 3 critical FreeSWITCH vulnerabilities: actively exploited RCE CVE-2026-116779, plus CVE-2026-116785 and CVE-2026-116790.

author: SecurityAr58409
text: CVE-2026-41709: VMware ESXi insufficient logging actively exploited; added to CISA KEV Oct 28.

author: BadgerSignalHQ
text: ShinyHunters (UNC6240) exploited CVE-2026-35273, a critical (CVSS 9.8) zero-day chain in Oracle PeopleSoft, no login needed.

author: DarkWebInformer
text: Threat actors scanning for CVE-2026-101767, a critical unauthenticated SQL injection in Oracle E-Business Suite chainable to RCE.

author: PenTestBids
text: CVE-2026-110447: critical Nextcloud command injection actively exploited (CVSS 9.2).

author: Dinosn
text: Supply chain attack compromises Convertr e-commerce platform.

author: undercode_news
text: GhostAction's latest GitHub supply chain attack fizzles out, but thousands of developer accounts remain exposed.

author: JtCrawford
text: 26,400 live credentials exposed on Gitee: database strings, API keys, cloud tokens.
